title: e
description: Grow by 100% once, and you double. Grow by 1% a hundred times, and you get 2.70... Grow continuously, and you get e. Unlocks the e Crystal.

puzzle.goal: Grow by 1/n of the whole, n times in a row. Write the factor G you end up multiplied by.
puzzle.name: Compound growth
puzzle.ask: Find G for n = @{n} (nearly continuous growth).
puzzle.method: Each step multiplies by 1 + 1/n; as n grows the product settles on 2.71828..., which is e.
